provenance_note: Body traces use the per-run recorded binary. The final rebuild only corrects failed-trace flipped_after reporting and adds terminal locations plus a focused regression; it does not change repair. Older failed snapshots have stale diagnostics.flipped_after, so final counts here are independently recomputed from the saved integer lattice. The matched hand ran before diagnostic instrumentation; its exact binary hash was not captured.
changes: SAT attempts report propagation, encoding and search time with separate local-UNSAT and budget outcomes.
Coarse patches report depth, radius, sizes, fixed boundaries, locked coordinates and representative inversion locations.
Audit repair-trace adds flushed JSONL events, atomic completed-pass checkpoints, same-input validation and cooperative deadlines.
Cancelled/rejected traces save attempted lattice and explicit rejection status; final code refreshes inversion counts even on failure.
Standard-library Python summarizer groups locations generically at Euclidean distance 2h and excludes interrupted attempts from timings.

final_body.largest_patch: Contains 64 inversions, including the 62-cell junction cluster, with no locked guide coordinates. At depth 5/radius 1 it has 356 faces/496 flexible edges; at depth 0/radius 4 it has 7539 faces/11062 flexible edges. It hits search time/work limits, not patch-size limits.
final_body.next_experiment: Replay the frozen junction patch independently, compare native and pinned upstream search/encoding and fixed-boundary effects before changing objectives. Investigate coarse-hand allocation/fitting separately.

limits: No accepted full-body mesh or matched-spacing hand.
Only coarse SAT patches are profiled individually; fine repair records stages and final state, not per-patch statistics.
Local UNSAT assumes current patch boundaries, frame rotations and domains; budget exhaustion is not infeasibility.
Repeated portions of an interrupted coarse pass count again in resumed trace timing.
Checkpoints preserve completed coarse passes only; fine-stage resume repeats fine repair.
Fingerprint is an accidental-mismatch guard for trusted same-build fixtures, not cryptographic verification.
Representative centers are field triangle centers; Euclidean diagnostic clusters may bridge nearby surface sheets.
Finite sampled distances do not certify global Hausdorff distance or absence of intersections.
No painting, multiple-path UI, persistence, platform or CI validation in this batch.
